subject: Re: Project timeline change
text:
Following up on our thread, the project update is now due two days earlier because the department is finalizing the spring showcase list this afternoon. I have completed the first survey draft, cleaned the responses, and prepared a short summary for your review. I can still send the formatted version by 5:00 p.m. tomorrow, but I will need confirmation today on the logo colors and one sentence for the client overview.

If the deadline remains tight, I suggest we leave the extra charts as a separate appendix rather than rebuilding the slides. That keeps the core section consistent and avoids another round of last-minute edits. I have also scheduled a short check-in at noon in case anything urgent appears.

Let me know if this revised timing works or needs adjustment today.
